name: neblex
description: Build, test and run integrations, workflows, forms, apps and AI agents in Neblex Integration Fabric (iPaaS) from Kimi Code, through the hosted Neblex MCP server with OAuth sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Build workflows and AI agents with built-in data quality
interface.longDescription: Connects Kimi Code to Neblex Integration Fabric, an integration platform (iPaaS). Build and test flows from a prompt, open a failed run and see the step and record it broke on, add deduplication and validation steps, and check flow health across 300+ connectors. OAuth sign-in with two-factor; you choose the scopes on the consent screen.

neblex.description: Hosted Neblex MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth)
